flags: The API's Guardian / Walker / Patron positions don't line up with the reworked map (the two 'core' points land outside it), so they're drawn as approximate and the cores are left out.
We read the API's 'titan' objective as the Patron, and its 'soul_urn_pads' as the Urn drop-off points — check in-game.
Haunt tiers are matched to the API's camp sizes (weak / medium / strong → Tier I / II / III), and 'vault' camps to Sinner's Sacrifice. Some camps may be mislabelled.
Base Guardians, Shrines and the Mid-Boss pit have no positions in the API data, so they aren't drawn.

layers.label: Lanes & ziplines
layers.text: 3 lanes, each with a zipline from your base out to the lane. Ride it back out after you respawn instead of walking.

layers.label: Guardians, Walkers, Patron
layers.text: Each lane has a Lane Guardian, then a Walker behind it. They must fall in order: Guardian → Walker → Base Guardians → Shrines → Patron. Amber markers are the south team, sapphire the north team.

layers.label: Base sentries
layers.text: Marked as 'base sentries' in the game data, at the back of each base. Their behaviour isn't covered by our sources yet.

layers.label: Shops
layers.text: Your base shop, a side shop by each lane's first Guardian (it closes for good once that Guardian dies) and two secret shops in the underground tunnels that both teams can use.

layers.label: Haunts
layers.text: Jungle camps in three tiers. Tier I spawns first; respawns are 1:25 (Tier I), 4:50 (Tier II) and 5:35 (Tier III) after clearing. Marker size shows the tier.

layers.label: Sinner's Sacrifice
layers.text: Slot-machine vaults. Light melee = 1 buff, heavy melee = 4 buffs on the jackpot. Respawns 5 min after being broken.

layers.label: Soul Urn
layers.text: Spawns next to a bridge, alternating Yellow / Green side (first one is always Yellow). Carry it to the drop-off on the far side for team souls and 4 random permanent buffs. Rings = spawn spots, filled = drop-off pads.

layers.label: Unstable Rift
layers.text: Capture point. Stand in it to capture (12s; faster for the team that's behind). The winner gets Rift Troopers pushing for them.

layers.label: Bridge powerups
layers.text: Powerups appear on the bridges near the Urn spots. Heavy-melee to claim. Lasts 160s.

layers.label: Bell Tower
layers.text: Hitting things there rings a bell everyone hears (with a minimap ping).

layers.label: Teleporters
layers.text: Teleporter pairs from the game data. The dashed line joins each one to its exit.

layers.label: Steam Vents
layers.text: Standing on one makes you invisible, heals you, and gives +150% stamina regen.

layers.label: Bounce pads
layers.text: Pads that launch you into the air — a fast way up to rooftops and across gaps. The arrow runs from each pad to where it lands you (landing spots from the game data).

layers.label: Climb ropes
layers.text: Ropes you can climb to get up to higher floors.

layers.label: Cosmic Veils
layers.text: One-way walls of mist at juke rooms and under arches: you can't see enemies on the far (grey) side.

layers.label: Buff Containers
layers.text: Golden statues. 50% chance to drop a permanent stat booklet; respawn 3 min after being broken.

layers.label: Healing Snacks
layers.text: Hidden around the map; each heals 14% max HP.

layers.label: Crates
layers.text: Break them for souls; each respawns 3 min after it's broken.
